statement: Let S be normal integral noetherian of characteristicp, t its generic point, s any point, and V a locally free finite-rank module with p-linear endomorphism. fate: The fixed-point scheme is affine étale since the Jacobian of F(v)−v is−I. Over the henselization at s, its part meeting the closed fibre is a finite étale subgroup, with exactly the special Galois representation. Normality makes connected finite étale covers generically connected. Descent of the finite subgroup and its finite splitting torsor to an elementary étale neighbourhood supplies the required finite generic extension. Stacks0BTN,04GK,02LP were opened for the precise finite-part and henselian facts. This reviewer repair certifies the generic-point reduction, not the original arbitrary-point quantifier.
